MemTest86 passes on Pass 1 and then instantly fails on Pass 2
Hi so I'm not sure what to do here. My wife got me a new pc for my birthday last month and it's been a challenging ride 😅 It's my first time building from scratch. I understand some things but I'm still learning a lot. I knew enough to be confident in the build. 
After many issues (including a bent pin on the motherboard which had to be replaced) the pc was finally running and running great. I had a good friend walking me through how to undervolt the CPU and we were getting great results. 
In the last few days I've been getting a lot of blue screens. My initial thought was to revert the pbo to its default settings. Still getting blue screens. After looking at everything I could my friend tells me about memtest86. I run it and it passes on its first pass and then instantly fails as it starts the second. Totalling 174 errors. My build up to this point:

Asus ROG Strix B650E-E
GeForce RTX 4070ti
Ryzen 9 7900x
32gb DDR5 G.Skill TridentZ5
Currently running windows 11

So I buy new RAM. 32gb DDR5 Corsair vengeance. Install, boot up, everything running smooth. Start playing DayZ. No issues. Then I get off the game and 10 minutes later I get a blue screen. I reboot and run MemTest86 again. Instantly 24 errors that quickly builds to 144. 
At this point I'm broken. I shut down and walk away for half an hour. Then after enough of a sulk I go back and decide I'll try different DIMM slots. So I move my RAM from slots 2 and 4 to slots 1 and 3. Pc wont boot. I restart a couple times. Still no boot. So I decide to go back to slots 2 and 4 and run the test again. Pass 1, 0 errors. Pass 2 instantly 8 errors. As it stands now I am 40% through pass 2 and still have 8 errors.  
Any insights would be appreciated. I can't seem to add an image but the error on the blue screen with the Corsair ram was:
Stop code ATTEMPTED TO WRITE READONLY MEMORY
What failed ndis.sys
